info.title: Jules Dispatch API
info.description: API for sending messages and uploading files to the Jules Dispatch bot. Each deployment has a unique Convex site URL.

convexSiteUrl.description: Your unique Convex site URL from .env.local CONVEX_SITE_URL. Each deployment has a different URL.

post.summary: Send a message to the Jules bot
post.description: Sends a text message to the Jules Dispatch bot, which will be processed by the agent. Requires CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY for authentication.

message.description: The message text to send to the bot

200.description: Message sent. If the agent responded within the timeout, the response is included. If not, timedOut is true and you can poll /api/get-response with the threadId.

response.description: The agent's latest response text, or null if timed out

timedOut.description: True if the agent did not respond within the timeout window

400.description: Bad request - missing message or no user configured

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing deploy key

post.summary: Get the latest agent response for a thread
post.description: Polls for the latest assistant response in a thread. Use this after a send-message call that returned timedOut: true.

threadId.description: The thread ID returned by send-message

200.description: Latest agent response (or null if not ready yet)

response.description: The agent's latest response text, or null if no response yet

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing deploy key

post.summary: Upload a file to the Jules bot
post.description: Uploads a file to the Jules Dispatch bot with optional caption and prompt. Files are stored in Convex storage and notifications are sent via Telegram. Max file size: 20MB. Requires CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY for authentication.

prompt.description: Optional prompt to process after file upload

400.description: Bad request - missing file or no user configured

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing deploy key
